about: Voice-design option catalogue for the Voices page's design models. Every phrase is a neutral description of a voice, never a named person, character or brand; adults only (21 and over). Carried over from the studio's earlier copilot, with suggestive options removed or renamed.

groups.label: Voice presentation
groups.help: Who is speaking (adult voices only).

groups.label: Age feel (21+ only)
groups.help: Adult age bands only: 21 and over.

groups.label: Language (FireRedTTS3 supports these)
groups.help: The 24 languages in the FireRedTTS3 README. Cloning is benchmarked in all of them; voice design is benchmarked in English and Chinese only.

groups.label: Accent: English varieties and regions
groups.help: A region or community of English speakers. Design-input words; not benchmarked per accent.

groups.label: Accent: English spoken with another first language
groups.help: English as spoken by people whose first language is another one. Design-input words; not benchmarked per accent.

groups.label: Voice register and pitch
groups.help: How high or low the voice sits, and how the pitch moves.

groups.label: Timbre and texture
groups.help: The grain of the voice.

groups.label: Vocal quirks (fry, uptalk, smile...)
groups.help: Small habits that make a voice recognisable.

groups.label: Articulation and diction
groups.help: How clearly words are formed.

groups.label: Speaking pace
groups.help: How fast the words come.

groups.label: Rhythm and pauses
groups.help: How the words are grouped and spaced.

groups.label: Energy level
groups.help: How much push is in the voice.

groups.label: Baseline emotion and mood
groups.help: The mood the voice sits in by default.

groups.label: Warmth and formality
groups.help: How close or formal the voice feels.

groups.label: Confidence and attitude
groups.help: The stance behind the words.

groups.label: Delivery style
groups.help: A way of speaking, described by role, never by a named person.

groups.label: Volume and projection
groups.help: How loud and how projected.

groups.label: Breathiness and mouth noise
groups.help: Breaths and small mouth sounds.

groups.label: Laughter style
groups.help: How the voice laughs when it does.

groups.label: Recording character
groups.help: The sound of the room and the microphone.
